title: cyclosorus immersus
intro: Cyclosorus immersus, commonly known as the Chinese water fern or water clover, is a type of aquatic fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including the ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and improve blood circulation. Therapeutically, Cyclosorus immersus is reported to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardio-protective actions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include various compounds such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
